name: fab
title: Floating action button
description: Keeps one task reachable over scrolling content, as a button or a link, collapsing to its icon on phones.

when: One main task must stay reachable while people scroll: contact, new item.

guidance.rule: At most one per screen; never over a dialog or sheet.

builtIn: Keeps its label as the accessible name when collapsed to an icon.
Links that open a new tab say so.
youProvide: A verb label for the task.
